scope: Targeted semantic consolidation of recent working translations and their IP follow-ups; not an exhaustive adjudication of all 82 ideas or all historical records.
relationship_scope: Relations apply to the explicitly named hypothesis component, never automatically to complete experiments. No record identities or events are merged.
rank_meaning: Lower rank means greater value for future evidence acquisition, not permission or readiness to execute. No entry currently supplies a new score-ready meaning test.
method: Current route, bounded ideas search/show, compact lookup pointers, and direct primary reports. No raw manuscript data, images or network access.

groups.hypothesis: Complete okaiin denotes a property rather than an anaphoric possessive relation; warm is one fixed candidate, not an established property value.
groups.shared_component: GDT815 explicitly retains GDT814 Q=warm? and R=possessive dessen? while adding cold and bitter alternatives and written carrier chains.
distinct_variants: GDT814 tests complete contexts and an isolated okaiin dan inscription.
GDT815 adds particular possible antecedents okol and otedy; these do not establish reference or property ownership.
Warm, cold, bitter and an unspecified property are distinct candidate values, not synonyms.
gates: An independently constrained property-bearing versus antecedent-dependent relation that changes a fixed model prediction.
Keep unknown heads and antecedents unknown; label/prose reuse is not an authorial reference edge.
Any formal relation scoring must satisfy the applicable registered provenance, capacity and held-data gates.
not_sufficient: Another property-compatible slot
Substituting warm/cold/bitter after observing a scene
Reusing historical humoral descriptions as a Voynich value key

groups.hypothesis: The retained N candidate assigns complete okaiin the trial meaning Pulver/powder.
groups.identity_limit: Exact duplicate of this declared word assignment only. The experimental comparisons and evidence packages remain separate records.
gates: Independent evidence distinguishing powder/material from property and reference while keeping the other trial words fixed.
not_sufficient: Repeated rendering of the same f17r.11 sentence
Nominal role compatibility
Counting the retained candidate as three independent positive findings

groups.hypothesis: The retained G candidate assigns complete okaiin the trial meaning ist/is.
groups.identity_limit: Exact duplicate of this declared word assignment only; neither the N/G comparison nor later added Q/R comparisons are duplicate complete experiments.
gates: Independent subject/predicate evidence or an explicitly justified elliptical construction, with contrasting consequences for the other fixed candidates.
not_sufficient: A fluent German sentence
Treating the standalone f88v label as a universal logical refutation of every copular use
Supplying invisible subjects differently at each occurrence

groups.hypothesis: Complete qokaldy is an occurrence-dependent text reference rather than a mobile content noun or apposition.
groups.shared_component: IP023's audited instantiation uses the already-tested okaldy qokaldy pair on f33r.2 and the f66r paragraph repetition.
distinct_variants: The abstract IP023 idea of selecting one of two antecedents would be a distinct discriminator if an independent selecting observation existed; the cited instantiation does not supply it.
gates: A particular independently constrained antecedent selection or reference operation beyond the already-exposed adjacent pair and paragraph membership.
not_sufficient: Renaming davon as selective memory
The same okaldy qokaldy contact
Running-only distribution or alternate readings counted as independent witnesses

groups.hypothesis: IP071 requires literal predecessor-dependent expansion of a fixed short sign; GDT798/IP023 concern broader anaphoric reference.
groups.why_not_duplicate: A pronoun can refer without copying a complete preceding field. A ditto expansion imposes a stronger, different written equality.
gates: The same short sign after different predecessors, with independently bound full renderings that copy the respective different contents.
not_sufficient: Assuming qokaldy is a ditto sign
Ordinary reference compatibility
Marginal alignment

groups.hypothesis: Partitive/reference davon, anaphoric possessive dessen, and material-source daraus followed by becomes are different proposed relations.
groups.why_not_duplicate: GDT814 explicitly excludes partitive and origin interpretations from its fixed R model. GDT824 combines source reference and a predicate and retains repeated-predicate debt. Shared English or German reference terminology does not make them one word hypothesis.
gates: Specify one exact referential relation, source unit and independent selecting observation before comparing candidates.
not_sufficient: Merging all reference glosses
Borrowing a downstream material backwards to fill a missing source
Treating qolchedy composition as a general qol-prefix translation

groups.hypothesis: Complete cthy is leaf material or aerial herb drug, displayed as Blattgut.
groups.shared_component: GDT625 introduces this working default; GDT768 retains it among six whole-form anchors while testing other lexical rival assignments.
groups.identity_limit: Shared inherited lexical hypothesis, not independent confirmation and not duplicate full experiments.
gates: Evidence discriminating leaf material from broader aerial herb/content classes without using the inherited leaf gloss to label its contexts.
not_sufficient: Reprinting a concrete reader
Herbal concentration or nearby part words alone
Treating whole-form default reuse as independent semantic replication

groups.hypothesis: GDT625 uses dair as a root carrier; GDT768 displays it as a measured portion/level II while preserving a local Herbal root-part rival.
groups.why_not_duplicate: These assignments differ substantively even though the same surface and some source contexts recur. They must remain alternative or revised guesses, not a single stable translated lexeme.
gates: Independent observation distinguishing a material referent from a quantity/portion relation at a fixed occurrence.
not_sufficient: Calling a renderer change confirmation
Using the old root assignment as gold for the later portion test

groups.hypothesis: IP067 asks for an explicit operation and its undo; GDT625 reports formal three-state sequences and conditional process interpretations.
groups.why_not_duplicate: An A-B-A sequence is not itself a written inverse operator. The intended discriminator is distinct, but its independent state/traversal source is not established.
gates: A fixed written undo expression across different operations with independently established return states and the same carrier.
not_sufficient: Interpreting inherited dry/moist labels as known values
Another three-state census
An A-B-A illustration without a written operation

groups.hypothesis: IP074 asks whether two complete interpretations can be observationally distinguished; the reports provide only partial competing constructions.
groups.why_not_duplicate: A methodological question is not another powder/property/pronoun assignment. The sources do not establish two complete observationally equivalent readings.
gates: Two explicitly complete models and at least one fixed observable with different predictions.
not_sufficient: Claiming universal equivalence from current underdetermination
Another fluent partial rendering
